# FileForge

> Free online file converter with 33 browser-based and API-powered tools for images, PDFs, documents, video and audio. No signup, no watermarks, 50MB max per file.

FileForge helps people convert files without installing software. Image, PDF and text conversions run locally in the browser using Canvas, PDF.js and pdf-lib, so those files never leave the device. Word, Excel, PowerPoint and audio/video conversions use a third-party conversion API over HTTPS. All tools are free.

## Key facts

- 33 conversion tools across 5 categories: image, PDF, document, video, audio.
- Maximum file size: 50MB per file.
- No registration, no watermark, no subscription.
- Image, PDF and text tools process files client-side.
- Privacy policy: https://fileforge-iota.vercel.app/privacy
